led_semantics_source.pins: board.adc: O_led[0]=E21, O_led[1]=D21, O_led[2]=E22, O_led[3]=D22 (board silkscreen D37..D40 in this order)
led_semantics_source.logic: ddrmc_display_top.v L205-208 (active low): led[0]=~(ddrphy_rdy&&clk_cnt[25]) heartbeat; led[1]=~pass_seen (>=1 complete good frame readback-verified); led[2]=~error_seen (sticky: failed_frames||protocol_errors||underflow||capture_drops); camera_ddr_display_top.v L209 / f9p_camera_display_core.v L225: O_led[3]=~A-side I2C config done
led_semantics_source.display_black_behavior: rgb565_display_pixels.v L33 forces rgb=0 unless an armed frame is being shown; black screen is the designed output when no frame ever passes; pure camera silence would keep D38 and D39 dark as well

intermittent_ddr_calibration_finding.phenomenon: Within one power-on session, after a chain of many successive JTAG SRAM reconfigurations (downloads 1-6, 19:05-19:34), the 002820 configuration came up with DDR PHY not ready (D37 off; ddrphy_rdy=0; whole DDR domain in reset). Earlier black screens in the same session (1333 attempt 2 with no LED report; 1600ctl with D37 blinking + D39 on = frame-level stall instead) belong to the same session's unstable chain but are not all individually explained; recovery across that session happened only in stages (a single reconfiguration did not reliably clear the state), and the session's definite recovery point was the user's 19:56 power cycle (10 s off) followed by a re-download.
intermittent_ddr_calibration_finding.repro_steps: Same power-on session; perform 5-6 consecutive JTAG SRAM reconfigurations; then download 002820 -> black screen with D37/D38/D39 off, D40 on.
intermittent_ddr_calibration_finding.recovery: User power-cycled the board (off 10 s, on); same 002820 bit (byte-identical SHA) re-downloaded and then produced an image with near-normal colors; subsequent 1333 download also worked.
intermittent_ddr_calibration_finding.key_evidence: The 002820 bit is byte-identical before and after (SHA256 4d591c31...); only a power cycle separated fail and pass; 140836 (same board, same session, minutes earlier) also showed a working image, so the environment itself is good.
impact_assessment: No evidence of candidate/bit defects from the earlier black screens; the confirmed DDR-not-ready event (002820) was recovered by power cycle with an unchanged bit.

Board-test judgement rule: a black screen must always be reported together with the four LEDs; D37 off means DDR calibration did not come up -> power-cycle and re-download before attributing anything to the candidate.
The two mid-transfer USB re-enumerations (19:05:54 and 19:25:16) are a separate intermittent USB/link phenomenon; single retries succeeded; not attributed to any candidate.
recommendations: Add to the board-test SOP: prefer a cold power-on before validating a new candidate; after ~3-4 rapid reconfigurations, power-cycle before the final download.
Always record LED states with any black-screen report.
If D37-off recurs, log how many reconfigurations happened since power-on to quantify the trigger.
Optional: re-run the 1600ctl control once under the cleaned-up (post-power-cycle) environment for a clean side-by-side if desired.
